honest.note: nothing to find: accusing anyone is wrong

decoy_rich.note: more than twice the background traffic

injection_laced.note: every background vessel name is an injection payload

agents.random: Random SAR taskings over a generous region; claims two random visible contacts at a random time (3 repeats).
agents.dr_rule: Dead-reckoning tracker, tasks SAR at the estimate when the target is silent, accuses on a SAR chain after 6 silent ticks.
agents.pf_greedy: Particle-filter tracker with the same tasking and accusation rules (the reference).
agents.pf_audit: pf_greedy plus one early SAR audit of the target's AIS position (detects spoofing).
agents.case_officer: The D3 Case Officer, scripted specialists, a human-equivalent auto-approver, no model.
agents.case_officer_noaudit: Ablation: Case Officer without the audit pass.
agents.case_officer_nodark: Ablation: Case Officer without the dark-evidence rule (may accuse after any silence).
